neighbours.label: measuring or describing water and other fluids as an environment or medium
fire: Samples from the estuary showed that the salinity of the water fell after the rains.
Engineers recorded the flow rate and the temperature of the stream below the dam.
Divers measured how clear the water of the reservoir was at three different depths.
The pond's water chemistry shifted when runoff raised its phosphate concentration.
Salmon returned once the river had colder water and a steadier summer flow.
Tidal currents mix the seawater in the bay and carry nutrients toward the shore.
The fluid's viscosity and pressure were logged at each point along the pipe.
Monsoon floods covered a quarter of the delta and raised the groundwater table.
quiet: Samples from the hillside showed that the acidity of the soil fell after the fires.
Engineers recorded the height and the condition of the road below the pass.
Surveyors measured how steep the slope of the quarry was at three different points.
The meadow's plant diversity shifted when grazing raised its share of thistles.
Deer returned once the forest had thicker cover and a steadier supply of acorns.
Strong winds shape the dunes along the plain and carry sand toward the town.
The beam's stiffness and length were logged at each stage of the build.
Wildfires burned a quarter of the savanna and left the upland pastures bare.

notes: Card peaks are scattered function words inside water, habitat and fluid text; probes gave 0.39 for river water, 0.33 for air density and 0.003 for an office sentence. The + pole's output promotes 'density'. Near misses keep the scientific survey style on land.
